question: Where should the syllable of love be inscribed on the drawn image?
premises: The image has been marked at key points.
A love syllable is to be inscribed.
It should permeate the whole body.
inference: Therefore, having drawn it, one inscribes the love syllable merged into all the joints of the limbs.
plain_english: Having drawn it, one inscribes the love syllable merged into all the joints of the limbs.
